title: 📱 New Leak: Motorola’s Upcoming Foldable Phone with a Wide Design and an Unannounced Chip!
body: 📱 New Leak: Motorola’s Upcoming Foldable Phone with a Wide Design and an Unannounced Chip!

A leaked certification document revealed the “Razr Flex 2027” phone, with a foldable inner display of nearly seven inches at 165Hz, a smaller outer display, and a new Qualcomm chip the company has not revealed yet, likely to be called the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Pro. A leaked photo of the phone from the back also appeared, in a beige color with a short, wide design resembling large foldable phones. The phone runs on Android 17, but Motorola has not confirmed any details officially yet.
Simply put: leaks talk about a foldable phone that is completely different in shape and performance.
Do you prefer wide foldable phones or small ones?
